featured_reviews.name: Hunney Pooh
featured_reviews.review_text:
A place specialising in variety of FRIES serves poor quality FRIES itself...I saw some allegedly paid reel about a ₹99 offer and thought of trying it and I don't understand how people are paying full price for such sub standard items. I'm glad I paid ₹99 only and felt even that price was too high for such poor quality product this should be nothing more than ₹50 it's that's bad.

Firstly they don't have a proper number listed on Google and number on Zomato is for an individual who just got the number recently. Then somehow found a contact number through some other website. I spoke to a nice lady who was quite over confident asking me to come before 06pm otherwise the place would be full after 6pm with no seats available. I went around 0730pm place was empty to my surprise both tables completely empty (the neighbouring joints had much more crowd I guess we know why).

I ordered the ALIEN fries after being explained by an elderly person at counter which all items were excluded in the offer (not mentioned in the reel). I choose the item as I was told it had combo of sauces. When I receive my order I already knew it's not gonna be good as being a foodie I can ascertain the quality of sauces used when I see it. The so called white cheese tasted mostly like veg mayo and no cheesy taste and they squirt so much of it. Same with jalapeno sauce had no such taste of anything tasted like sub standard mayo with different colours. I doubt they use good quality VEEBA cheese sauce or jalapeno sauce which actually have the distinct taste (no I'm not a sponsor of Veeba). For an outlet which has overpriced fries atleast ensure you use good quality sauces and shoe-string fries.

I usually visit the Shawarma Ji down the same lane (when I come to Kandivali in weekends) and have always found this place to be empty and u know I'm not lying when it's empty on a Sunday evening when they have special offer running which is circulating on social media and its still empty and it's located opposite a big garden (target audience -kids, teens , college found young adults).

I visited the place because I'm a fan of loaded fries (fries with toppings) and was deeply disappointed. If owners genuinely want to improve pls visit De Burger World in Bhy W opp Maxus Mall (this specific branch only) and order their Casket (Veg/Non Veg) without onions ask them to make it cheesy and see what amazing loaded fries you get when it's not even their speciality item (mentioned in bottom of the menu). It can be shared by two people easily and it's it's loaded with pickles, olives, jalapenos, shredded lettuce, achaar (chefs own twist) and yes good quality sauces & fries with topping of generous portion of chicken/paneer as per your preference all priced under ₹180. And before I am accused of sponsoring them let me clarify I have no relation to them personally or monetarily. I work closeby so me and my colleagues are regulars there and whoever have tried their Casket have always reordered them. I'm just a BIG foodie giving owners honest suggestion if they genuinely wanna improve their product (lena hai toh lo) and obviously to my fellow bhukkad foodies of a hidden gem.

Honestly I doubt if all these reviews giving it overall rating 4.7 stars are all genuine ?

customer_updates.name: Nishita Sharma
customer_updates.text:
I had one of the worst dining experiences at Fast Food Express. I ordered Veg Paneer Pulao, and to my surprise, there were no vegetables at all in it! It was just some rice tossed in sweet sauces with a few pieces of paneer – absolutely no taste, no balance, and definitely not what you expect from a “veg pulao”.

Then I tried the Manchurian Gravy, hoping it would be better, but that too was a complete disaster. The gravy was extremely spicy, overpowering, and had no flavor except heat. It felt like they just dumped chili for no reason.

But honestly, the worst part was the staff behavior. One of the staff members kept hovering around and repeatedly asked us to place the order even though I was still checking the menu. It felt rushed, pushy, and uncomfortable. No courtesy, no patience, no professionalism.

Overall, very disappointing food and service. Would not recommend this place at all.

👎👎👎

It’s rare to see someone so dedicated—he actively asks for feedback and ensures that every dish meets your expectations.

What impressed me the most is his willingness to make things right immediately. If something feels off in taste, he doesn’t hesitate to have it corrected or replaced, showing genuine care for customer satisfaction. This level of attentiveness creates a welcoming and comfortable dining environment.

customer_updates.text: Good food and amazing ambience. Good service. Slightly expensive for the quantity they provide. Good for occasional visits.

featured_reviews.name: Mchris P
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Pop Tates on a Friday evening mainly for the food. The place was completely crowded and very lively, with a cricket match playing, which added to the vibe. Since we weren’t there to drink, we just had water, and I ordered a ginger ale.
For starters, we wanted something spicy, so we asked for a chicken starter. The waiter suggested the Jamaican Jerk Chicken. It was not spicy at all and was slightly on the sweeter side, but it still tasted good on its own.
Next, we ordered Devil’s Paneer. The paneer was very soft and juicy, with a mild hint of spice. Not very spicy, but nicely done.
The Prawns Chilli was really good. The prawns felt fresh, were full of flavour, and again mildly spicy rather than hot.
We also ordered Cheesy Mushroom Bruschetta, which was rich, creamy, and very cheesy. The bruschetta was well toasted, and the combination worked really well.

Then we ordered for Tom Yum Soup. Now this was the worst soup we ever had. It tasted like a bad watery Tomato Rasam. I am sorry but yeah it was just bad.

For the main course, we ordered a Chicken Shashlik Sizzler and a Mexican Grilled Chicken Sizzler. The quantity was shockingly huge. The chicken was tender, well-seasoned, and full of flavour. The accompaniments that came with the sizzlers were also very good.
Overall, the food was excellent, the service was quick, and the staff were very attentive. Orders were taken and served promptly.
I would definitely visit Pop Tates again when I’m back in Mumbai but I have to deduct a star coz of the soup.

featured_reviews.name: Nitesh Patil

I had a pleasant experience as I was looking for a quick ‘linner.’ I tried the mac and cheese pasta along with a Green apple Caprioska cocktail, both of which were enjoyable. The cheesy garlic bread was well-prepared, and the berry cheesecake was a nice way to end the meal. The ambience is quite good, creating a comfortable dining environment. Valet parking is also available, which adds to the convenience.

featured_reviews.name: anjana hanra
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Pop Tate’s for dinner, and while the food did not disappoint, the overall experience had a few drawbacks.

We ordered:

Ginger Ale – Chilled refreshing drink

Chicken Manchow Soup – Warm, flavorful, and comforting.

Rice and Thai Curry – Absolutely delicious, rich in taste, and well-prepared.

Pepper Blasted Chicken – Spicy, tender, juicy, and fresh.

Ambiance & Service:

The restaurant had a lively atmosphere, but the music was too loud, making conversations a bit difficult. The service was also slightly slow, which took away from the experience.

Overall Verdict:

If you’re looking for great food with bold flavors, Pop Tate’s delivers. However, if you prefer a quieter dining experience with quick service, you might need some patience. Would revisit for the food but hope for improved service and a better noise level.
